name: Textarea
description: Textarea that grows on its own (field-sizing: content) between a minimum and maximum number of rows, with an optional resize handle, a group with a toolbar and an <mv-char-count> character counter.
useWhen: Users write multi-line text such as a comment, message, bio or description
The field should grow with its content between a minimum and a maximum number of rows
A character limit must be shown with a counter that warns near the limit
A composer needs a toolbar for formatting or attachment buttons next to the text

avoidWhen.when: The value is short and single-line, like a name or an email
Rich text such as headings, bold and links must render while typing; this field is plain text

classes.name: mv-textarea
classes.description: On <textarea>. Height adapts to the content.

classes.name: mv-textarea-group
classes.description: Shared container for textarea + toolbar (message composer, comment box).

classes.name: mv-textarea-toolbar
classes.description: Row of buttons below the textarea; data-divider adds a rule and a background.

classes.name: mv-textarea-toolbar-spacer
classes.description: Pushes the following items to the right.

attributes.name: data-size
attributes.description: Padding and text size; on .mv-textarea or .mv-textarea-group.

attributes.name: aria-invalid
attributes.description: Forces the error state; :user-invalid is also supported.

attributes.name: <mv-char-count for>
attributes.description: Tracked control (otherwise: the first textarea/input of the parent .mv-field or group).

attributes.name: <mv-char-count max>
attributes.description: Limit. Without maxlength it is a soft limit: the control becomes invalid past it.

attributes.name: <mv-char-count mode>
attributes.description: “42 / 280” or the number of characters left.

attributes.name: <mv-char-count data-variant>
attributes.description: Circular gauge; the number only appears near the limit.

methods.name: <mv-char-count>.refresh()
methods.description: Recomputes after a programmatic value change.

cssVars.name: --mv-textarea-max-rows
cssVars.description: Maximum height in rows before scrolling.

cssVars.name: --mv-char-progress
cssVars.description: 0 → 1, set by <mv-char-count> (use it for your own gauges).

a11y: Pair with a <label for>. <mv-char-count> adds its description (“120 characters left of 200”) to the control's aria-describedby without overwriting existing ids, and only announces (role=status) when crossing the warning threshold or the limit, not on every keystroke. The visible number is aria-hidden. Toolbar buttons are <button type="button"> with an aria-label.
